recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to TestScript.minimumId behavior or wording should be made in the HL7 FHIR Testing IG source, not by restoring or editing retired core TestScript/testing page source; revisit core only if its links to the Testing IG become stale or misleading.
issue_request: FHIR-37818 was a Published FHIR-core TestScript change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that TestScript.setup.action.assert.minimumId be specified more clearly for element ordering, value-less element presence checks, and fixture serialization format; the final resolution accepted clarification but rejected support for a <novalueelement/> sentinel, directing authors to use separate assertions for value-independent presence checks.
initial_application: The request was applied in core by commit 8784f97f340498d087383b2430744c21e4652502 on 2023-01-12. That commit added a Testing FHIR "Use minimumId" section to source/testing.html with source-fixture superset comparison, order-insensitive attribute/element and array matching when paths match, duplicate handling, and separate-assert guidance for presence without value.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-08-29 assigned Richard Ettema to draft the proposal, and minutes on 2023-01-09 record the vote accepting it with the <novalueelement/> removal. Current core no longer owns TestScript source: commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed testscript, testreport, and testplan from active source/fhir.ini resource metadata and deleted source/testing.html while adding the FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG. Current core links TestScript material to that IG, whose current build contains the migrated Use minimumId guidance.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because the authoritative TestScript and minimumId documentation are outside the current core build, and the current external Testing IG already contains the applied minimumId clarification.
